description: Run Wells 1-3, the aerator, and sodium hypochlorite disinfection to produce treated water that meets the state-determined residual for 4-log virus treatment
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Usable storage (about 200,000 of the 450,000 gallons after fire reserve) covers about 12 hours at maximum day demand; unsafe or missing disinfection is a public health event and a Tier 1 notice trigger; RTO is the time to start production by hand, not to restore SCADA; RPO is the age of the last known-good PLC program and setpoints
manual_workaround: Hand-off-auto switches: operators run wells, aerator, and the hypochlorite pump by hand at the panels; the mechanical stroke limit and the analyzer's alarm relays to the alarm dialer stay active
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-01 (not needed in hand mode); SYS-12; plant power
dependent_third_parties: Chemical supplier; electric utility; fuel contractor; SCADA integrator

description: Keep system pressure with 3 high-service pumps controlled by the elevated tank level
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Low pressure risks backflow and leads to precautionary boil water notices; the high-service pumps follow the elevated tank level, which reaches the PLC through the tank RTU and modem
manual_workaround: Run a high-service pump by hand and watch the tank level gauge at the plant; field check at the tank

description: SCADA supervision from the control room, remote alarm call-out, and on-call remote access at night and on weekends
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without SCADA or remote alarms the plant must be staffed around the clock; 3 licensed operators can do that for about 2 days before fatigue becomes a safety risk; the alarm dialer still covers chlorine high and low, low tank level, power failure, and intrusion
manual_workaround: Staff the plant in 12-hour shifts; rely on the alarm dialer and hourly rounds; ask the county utility or a neighboring system for a relief operator after 48 hours
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-12; internet line
dependent_third_parties: SCADA integrator; remote monitoring vendor; cellular carrier; internet provider

description: Continuous chlorine residual monitoring at the entry point, monthly bacteriological samples, lab results, and the monthly operating report to the primacy agency
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: If the continuous analyzer or its record fails, grab samples every 4 hours are required until it is back, and continuous monitoring must resume within 14 days (40 CFR 141.403(b)(3)(i)(A)); the daily lowest residual must still be recorded; a missed requirement must be reported within 48 hours (141.31(b))
manual_workaround: Grab samples every 4 hours with the portable colorimeter, logged on paper; lab samples continue through the contract laboratory courier
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (local historian); SYS-02; SYS-05 (trend history); SYS-06 (lab reports by email)
dependent_third_parties: Contract certified laboratory; remote monitoring vendor

description: Decide and deliver boil water and other public notices; consult the primacy agency; notify the school and customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A Tier 1 notice must reach persons served no later than 24 hours after the system learns of the situation, and primacy agency consultation must start within 24 hours (40 CFR 141.202(b)); the team needs the contact list and a template within 4 hours to meet that
manual_workaround: Printed contact list and notice template in the plant binder; door hangers and posting; local radio; county emergency management
dependent_systems: SYS-07 (customer contact list); SYS-06 (templates and email); company phones
dependent_third_parties: Primacy agency; local radio stations; county emergency management
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner and General Manager; Chief Operator; Customer Service and Billing Clerk

description: Answer customer calls, run the monthly billing cycle, take payments, and process autopay drafts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $92,000 is billed each month; a delayed cycle defers cash but does not lose it, and the cash reserve covers about 45 days; customers calling about an outage need an answer the same day
manual_workaround: Office phone with a scripted message; paper call log; delay the billing cycle; payments continue on the processor's hosted page
dependent_third_parties: Billing SaaS vendor; payment processor; bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Customer Service and Billing Clerk; Office Manager

description: Monthly drive-by meter reads, service orders, line repairs, flushing, and remote site checks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reads can be estimated for one cycle under the tariff; urgent repairs are dispatched by phone
manual_workaround: Estimate one cycle; paper service orders; printed system maps
dependent_systems: SYS-09 (field laptop and meter-reading handheld); SYS-07

description: Payables, payroll, HR records, insurance, and vendor management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; vendors accept short delays; the cash reserve covers about 45 days
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll SaaS; pay urgent vendors by bank portal
dependent_third_parties: Accounting and payroll SaaS vendor; MSP; bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Office Manager; Owner and General Manager
